name: Vercel AI SDK
rationale: AI SDK integrations need explicit server/tool boundaries so prompts, model calls, tool execution, and provider keys do not leak into UI or generic shared modules.

directories.purpose: Server-owned model calls, prompts, and tool orchestration.

fileRules.name: AI Tool Safety Boundary
fileRules.rule: Model calls, provider keys, and tool execution must stay in server-owned AI/tool modules.
fileRules.trigger: A non-server/non-tool file imports AI provider or model-call libraries.
fileRules.recommendation: Move model calls and tool orchestration to src/server/ai or src/tools and pass safe results to UI.
fileRules.goodExample: src/server/ai/summarize.ts owns model calls and exposes a typed service result.
fileRules.badExample: A UI component imports OpenAI or AI SDK model-call helpers directly.

detectors.description: Flags AI/model-call imports outside server/tool modules.

moduleBoundaries: Server AI modules own prompts, provider configuration, model calls, and tool invocation.
UI and shared modules consume typed results, not provider clients or secrets.
testingExpectations: Add tests or eval fixtures for routing, tool-call safety, and output contract behavior.
agentInstructions: Do not move model calls or tool execution into UI files; require evidence before claiming AI behavior is fixed.
